usefulness_measure: Lossless token reduction >=10% against canonical on matched held-out document excerpts, or a separately documented native-tokenizer interoperability use case. Do not count an encoding/adapter error as a model failure.
selection: ID-hash order only; first48 valid documents screen, next96 independent documents confirm. No document selection by model loss. Every candidate uses exactly the same raw prefix and suffix per document.
limitations: 12k uniform-pool checkpoint is provisional while training continues to20k. 150k/published vocabularies may be outside32k..128k training support; report separately. Confirmation CI is per fixed pair; report all tested pairs without claiming population coverage.
